EVOS Legends 2022.notes: Represented Indonesia and captured Gold at the IESF World Esports Championship 2022 in Bali, taking down Team Philippines in the Grand Final.

ONIC Esports 2019.notes: The immortal Five Kage roster that recorded an unprecedented undefeated streak across MPL ID Season 3 and captured the MSC 2019 title in Manila.

ONIC Esports 2021.notes: MPL ID Season 8 and ONE Esports MPLI 2021 Champions. Snapped RRQs domestic reign and defeated Blacklist International to take the international MPLI trophy.

ONIC PH 2019.notes: Originally known as Dream High Gaming before being acquired by ONIC. The historic origin point of the legendary V33Wise duo alongside Dlar and Iy4knu.

ONIC PH 2023.notes: A disciplined, fast-paced ONIC PH roster that made deep playoff runs in MPL PH Season 11 and 12, showcasing the emergence of Super Frince and Sensui.

Geek Fam ID 2023.notes: The historic Cinderella Run of Geek Fam! Led by captain Baloyskie, they broke years of playoff heartbreak to reach the MPL ID S12 Grand Final and M5 Knockout Stage.

Burmese Ghouls 2020.notes: Myanmars most legendary esports squad. Made a historic run to the M2 World Championship Grand Final, pushing Bren Esports all the way to Game 7 in a thrilling series.

Burmese Ghouls 2024.notes: The resurgence of the Ghouls. Boosted by veteran Filipino import Dlar, they swept the domestic scene in MPL Myanmar Season 6 to qualify for M6.

Vampire Esports 2023.notes: Thailands premier esports powerhouse establishing their presence in MLBB, winning regional tournaments and competing in the Snapdragon Pro Series.

Vampire Esports 2024.notes: Thailands top representative in international qualifiers and EACC events, known for disciplined macro and explosive marksman play.

Bigetron Alpha 2022.notes: The transition era of Bigetron Alpha featuring the rise of midlaner Moreno alongside Maxxx and franchise pillar captain Kyy.

Bigetron Alpha 2023.notes: Powered by rookie sensation Super Kenn, Bigetron finished 3rd in MPL ID Season 12 and reached the Grand Finals of the Snapdragon Pro Series SEA.

AURA Fire 2023.notes: Famous for their high-octane entertainment style with Arans unorthodox sidelane picks and Kabukis trademark Chou and deadly marksman rotations.

AURA Fire 2024.notes: Made headlines by signing M4 World Champion roamer Yawi from ECHO, bringing aggressive Filipino roamer shotcalling to the Indonesian circuit.

Twisted Minds 2023.notes: MPL MENA Fall 2023 Champions! Represented Saudi Arabia and the MENA region at the M5 World Championship in Manila with standout performances.

Twisted Minds 2024.notes: Undisputed kings of MPL MENA Season 5, representing host nation Saudi Arabia at the prestigious Esports World Cup (MSC 2024) in Riyadh.

10s Gaming Frost 2019.notes: The global fan favorites of the inaugural M1 World Championship in Kuala Lumpur! Captured hearts worldwide with their Baxia and Lolita picks, finishing in the top 6.

10s Gaming Frost 2020.notes: Represented Japan at the M2 World Championship in Singapore, showing great resilience and tactical discipline in group stage battles.

See You Soon 2021.notes: Inaugural MPL Cambodia Champions! Made history by putting Cambodian MLBB on the world map at the M3 World Championship in Singapore.

See You Soon 2024.notes: MPL KH Season 6 Champions. Reinforced by standout imports MP the King and Kousei, they represented Cambodia with impressive displays at MSC 2024.

Team SMG 2023.notes: Led by MSC and MPL champion Sasa alongside Filipino jungler Saxa, Team SMG battled their way through the M5 Wildcard into the M5 World Championship main stage.

Team HAQ 2022.notes: The ultimate fairytale in Malaysian MLBB history. Rose from the open qualifiers all the way to defeating TODAK in the Grand Final to claim the MPL MY S10 title and qualify for M4.

RSG PH 2021.notes: The debut season of RSG Philippines under Coach Panda. Built the core foundation of Nathzz, Demonkite, Aqua, and Emann that would conquer Southeast Asia the following year.

RSG SG 2021.notes: Singapores premier contenders in MPL SG Season 2, qualifying for the M3 World Championship and advancing to the upper bracket.

RSG SG 2023.notes: Total domestic dominance in Singapore, winning back-to-back MPL SG titles in Season 5 and Season 6 and flying the Singapore flag at M5.

Smart Omega 2020.notes: The original Omega Esports roster that reached the MPL PH Season 6 Grand Finals and represented the Philippines at the M2 World Championship in Singapore.

Execration 2019.notes: The beloved bad boys of Philippine MLBB during the early golden age of MPL PH, creating iconic rivalries and setting the stage for their historic MSC 2021 title.

BTK 2023.notes: MobaZane led an overhauled BloodThirstyKings squad to defeat The Valley in the NACT Spring 2023 Grand Finals, reclaiming the North American crown.

BTK 2024.notes: Dominated the North America Challenger Tournament (NACT) Spring 2024 to qualify for MSC 2024 at the Esports World Cup in Riyadh.

Alter Ego 2022.notes: The fan-favorite Dark Horse lineup starring Celiboy The Miracle Boy and veteran Midlaner Udil, known for thrilling comebacks and fierce high-tempo matches.

Alter Ego 2023.notes: Executed a sensational lower bracket run in the MPL ID Season 11 playoffs, eliminating Bigetron Alpha and RRQ to finish on the podium.

Team Falcons MY 2024.notes: Team Falcons established their Malaysian presence in MPL MY Season 14, fielding an aggressive roster blending seasoned veterans with fresh mechanical talent.

Red Canids 2022.notes: MPL Brazil Season 2 Champions! Dominant Brazilian force led by inspirational captain Lunna, securing their championship dynasty in South America.

Vivo Keyd Stars 2023.notes: Back-to-back MPL Brazil Champions in 2023 and M5 World Championship competitors, cementing Vivo Keyd Stars as Latin Americas elite standard.

Deus Vult 2021.notes: The pioneer CIS lineup led by SAWO and Sunset Lover that qualified for the M3 World Championship, laying the groundwork for Russian MLBB supremacy.

Team Spirit 2024.notes: MCC Season 3 & 4 Champions. Acquired the powerhouse Deus Vult roster and represented Russia/CIS at the Mid Season Cup (MSC 2024) at the Esports World Cup in Riyadh and M6 World Championship.

Team Spirit 2026.notes: MSC Season 2026 Champions. Acquired the powerhouse Team Spirit roster and represented Russia/CIS at the Mid Season Cup (MSC 2026).

Brute Force 2024.notes: MCC Season 3 Grand Finalists. Represented Russia and the CIS region in the MSC 2024 Wildcard stage at the Esports World Cup in Riyadh.

HomeBois 2024.notes: MPL MY Season 13 finalists who advanced through the Wildcard and reached the Knockout Stage of MSC 2024 in Riyadh. Led by import midlaner Udil and franchise superstar roamer Xorn.

Cloud9 2024.notes: NACT Spring 2024 Champions. Cloud9 entered MLBB by signing BTK's championship squad to represent North America at the MSC 2024 Mid Season Cup in Riyadh.

RRQ Akira 2024.notes: MPL LATAM Season 1 Champions. Dominated South America and represented Brazil / LATAM at the MSC 2024 Mid Season Cup in Riyadh.
